seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Player walks 3-cell steps on frame colours {1,4} inside the portal bbox; a step into a block kicks it instead.
Kicked chain slides 1 cell per tick, picking up blocks it hits, over {1,4,15}; stops at colour 2, the bounds, the player, or a socket interior (bbox inset 1) the block does not fit.
Clicking a block makes it the player; the old player stays as an inert husk (colour 14 with a centre of 4).
Sprites: colour 14 with a 5 centre (blocks) or 0 centre (player), plus a 0 edge on each player side touching a block. Cells a mover leaves revert to socket rim 4 / interior 1, else the majority of the nearest uncovered cells.
Hidden state: HUD row 63 shows (n+1)//2 zeros, n = actions this level, carried only when the incoming frame equals the last returned one (fallback n=2z-1). Unconfirmed: a fitting block filling a socket, actions 2/5/7.
